ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the effectiveness of the state's efforts to prevent it.
questions: What is the total amount of fraudulent activity in Minnesota?
How effective are the state's efforts to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the Medicaid system, and could lead to significant reforms.
